lines.text: Contact received. Keep your spacing, and watch each other.
lines.synthesisText: [urgent] Contact received. Keep your spacing, and watch each other.

lines.text: Steady, company. Pick your targets. Make it count.
lines.synthesisText: [firm] Steady, company. Pick your targets. Make it count.

lines.text: Easy now. Fall back together. No one goes alone.
lines.synthesisText: [concerned] Easy now. Fall back together. No one goes alone.

lines.text: Breathe. Find cover and get yourselves together. I need you alive.
lines.synthesisText: [reassuring] Breathe. Find cover and get yourselves together. I need you alive.

lines.text: Check your fire! Those are our people.
lines.synthesisText: [stern] Check your fire! Those are our people.

lines.text: Mind your lanes! Confirm your targets before you fire.
lines.synthesisText: [urgent] Mind your lanes! Confirm your targets before you fire.

lines.text: Enemy mech confirmed. Spread out. Keep clear of its guns.
lines.synthesisText: [focused] Enemy mech confirmed. Spread out. Keep clear of its guns.

lines.text: Heavy contact received. Use cover. Give it nothing easy.
lines.synthesisText: [firm] Heavy contact received. Use cover. Give it nothing easy.

lines.text: One less problem. How considerate of them.
lines.synthesisText: [amused] One less problem. How considerate of them.
